caption.en:
Monthly Stacko demo + Q&A, live.

15 minutes walking through Stacko. 15 minutes of open questions — including the ones we can't answer yet. Every feature is labelled on screen.

[DATE · TIME] — tap to set a reminder.

Book a meeting with our team.

SESSION STRUCTURE (30 min)
0:00–0:05 Welcome · 0:05–0:20 Demo (map → pin → stock → transactions → AI draft → roles → audit trail; tag anything not built as Concept) · 0:20–0:28 Q&A · 0:28–0:30 CTA: book a meeting.

RECAP POST (day after): slide 2 of this folder, filled with the real top 3 questions.
caption.ar:
ديمو ستاكو الشهري + أسئلة وأجوبة، مباشر.

[التاريخ · الوقت] — كبوس لتحطّ تذكير.
